title: Vulkan++
description: A lightweight, Fabric-based optimization modpack focusing on the Vulkan API renderer and essential performance tweaks for Minecraft 1.21.1.
body:
## Overview
**FabricVulkan** is a hyper-optimized, lightweight modpack designed to maximize your FPS and stability in Minecraft 1.21.1. Built on the Fabric loader, this pack replaces the standard OpenGL renderer with Vulkan API and includes carefully selected performance mods.

## Key Features
* **Vulkan Renderer:** Powered by *VulkanMod* to utilize modern GPU features for smoother gameplay and higher frame rates.
* **Logic & Engine Fixes:** Includes *Lithium* and *FerriteCore* to optimize memory usage, physics, and world generation chunk loading.
* **Network & World Gen:** Features *Krypton* and *Chunky* to optimize network packets and allow pre-generating chunks to eliminate exploration lag.
* **HUD Utilities:** Comes with *FPS Display* out of the box so you can monitor your performance metrics in real-time.

## Mod List
* **VulkanMod** — Vulkan API renderer implementation.
* **Lithium** — General physics and game logic optimizations.
* **FerriteCore** — Significant RAM usage reduction.
* **Chunky** — Pre-generates world chunks to prevent lag spikes during exploration.
* **Krypton** — Network stack optimization for better multiplayer connection.
* **ThreadTweak** — Adjusts game thread priorities for better CPU utilization.
* **VMP (VulkanMod Compatibility Version)** — Server-side/client-side performance improvements.
* **FPS Display** — Lightweight on-screen FPS counter.
* **Cloth Config API & Fabric API** — Essential core libraries for mod compatibility.

**SHADERS ADDED ONLY 1.21.9, 1.21.11 AND 26.1.2**
